title: Boulderz Climbing Centre

blurb: Boulderz offers climbing gyms in Toronto, Etobicoke, and Mississauga with beginner-friendly lessons and advanced training areas. They provide climbing lessons and programs for all skill levels, from beginners to seasoned pros. The gyms feature state-of-the-art walls with difficulty ranging from beginner to very advanced, and new routes are set weekly.
